title: Mrs. Vivien Hidary: "Perashat Kedoshim- Essential Holiness"

chapters.title: Introduction to Parashat Kedoshim and Yom Ha'atzmaut
chapters.about: Holiness and the independence of Israel

chapters.title: The Land of Israel as Eretz Zavat Chalav U'dvash
chapters.about: The meaning of milk and honey in the Torah

chapters.title: Defining Kedusha and Human Reciprocity
chapters.about: How holiness is activated through human interaction

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the concept of holiness in Parashat Kedoshim, linking it to the significance of Eretz Yisrael on Yom Ha'atzmaut. She discusses the nature of the land as flowing with milk and honey, emphasizing the necessity of human effort and interaction to activate holiness in both the land and the people.
questions: What is the meaning of Eretz zavat chalav u'dvash?
How does the land of Israel reflect the state of the people?
What is the difference between holiness by definition and activated holiness?
Why is human effort required to achieve Kedusha?
